title: No Pending Action Before a Live Endpoint
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word and $c$ a configuration of the stopped four-tape interpreter on input $x$. If $s<t$ and the interpreter has not halted at time $t$ from $c$, then at time $s$ its control state is not any pending-action state, for every choice of the eight action bits and halting flag.
replaced:
If the stopped table interpreter has not halted after $t$ steps from a
configuration, then at every time $s < t$ its control is not a pending-action
state, because the stopped interpreter halts one step after reaching such a
state.
